title: Journal of the Hollow
author: Unknown Cartographer
pages: We found the hollow by accident. The walls hum when the lanterns dim.
I marked the path with ash and rope, but the cave keeps shifting.
If you find this, leave a sign. The stone remembers your name.

title: Cult Ledger
author: Sister Veyra
pages: The choir gathered beneath the fractured light. The ritual holds.
Offerings are placed where the water glows. The rift listens.
Do not break the circle. The voices crawl from the cracks.

title: Bunker Notes
author: Ranger Hal
pages: Supply caches are buried under the old pines, north of the creek.
If the storm returns, shelter near the ruined tower. Avoid the bog.
Keep moving. The trees whisper when the sun goes out.

title: Rift Warnings
author: Archivist Lorne
pages: Beware the glow within the stone. It bends the mind.
Do not follow the voices. They are echoes, not allies.
Seal every entrance you open. The deep is hungry.
